title: Builder population member removal removes the mapped source member and restores the full population after undo
classificationNote: The Builder bootstrap parsing correction worked, and the native run reached Group construction and the related-resource chooser. The strict Raw Fields locator then matched 614 summaries instead of one. No mapped member removal, Apply, reload, or Undo transition was reached; no product failure is established.

dimensionInterpretation: Raw usability records a failed harness locator, not a product failure. Raw correctness passed only for the independent mapped/orphan fixture oracle and source freeze; the registered member-removal lifecycle checks were not reached. Persistence and performance remain untested.
